_comment: The trace-evaluation battery: judge dimensions run against every played trace, plus default context. The gm_* dimensions are the shared game-master adherence battery in evaluation/judges/ — the same briefs and schemas the runtime harness runs over a single interaction (loadTraceDimensionDefinition resolves shared ids first, then this directory). Mechanical checks (clue_accounting, spoiler_leak) are always-on and live in lib/mechanical.mjs, not here. mechanical_context tunes those deterministic checks. This is the game-master analogue of evaluation/dimensions/registry.json.
